reason: As a Ridgeview retiree on a fixed income, I'm more persuaded by B. It gives me the cost plainly up front ($120 a year, about $10 a month, ends after six years) and answers the blank-check worry respectfully. A's 'less than a cup of coffee' line feels flippant to someone counting every dollar, and its 'Here's what it actually is' sounds combative.
